label: D1 after a reward while the policy leans toward a2
explanation: It is active only at D1 steps where the reward input is 1 (the previous trial was rewarded) and the agent is about to choose a2. Its policy logit there is moderately negative, between -4.4 and -1.5 (a1 minus a2). It never fires at GO or D2, after unrewarded trials, or before a1 choices. Nearly all activations come after an a2 to S2 common rewarded trial, or at the window first trial. Recall is about 1.0 but precision is only about 0.39: it fires on roughly a third of rewarded D1 steps before an a2 choice, and the false positives look the same in observed history. The rate rises across the episode (trials 0-9 almost never; adding ep_trial >= 30 lifts dev F1 from 0.56 to 0.62). It is stronger when S2 is the hidden good state and value is not high (value < 7.7). Magnitudes are tiny (max 0.004), and what sets magnitude beyond this was not resolved. The predicate uses the model policy logit, which is computed at that step; the upcoming action == 2 version gives similar recall at precision 0.32.
